rationale: `dirty` is a `get` accessor on ReactiveEffect; watch.ts declares `let effect: ReactiveEffect` (line 146), assigns `new ReactiveEffect(getter)` (line 288), and reads `effect.dirty` inside the job at line 237, which runs the getter. Property reads of TypeScript getters are not captured as calls. The only getter-access rule (py-property-decorator-access) is Python-only, so no in-scope rule covers this.
